title: Atropos
description: Atropos is a finite mixture modeling (FMM) segmentation approach that allows for prior constraints including a prior label image, prior probability images, and/or an MRF prior to enforce spatial smoothing of the labels.

image_dimensionality.description: This option forces the image to be treated as a specified-dimensional image. If not specified, Atropos tries to infer the dimensionality from the first input image.
image_dimensionality.title: Image Dimensionality

intensity_image.description: One or more scalar images is specified for segmentation. For scenarios with no prior information, the first scalar image is used to order labelings by intensity. The optional adaptive smoothing weight is applicable with prior images, specified between [0,1].
intensity_image.title: Intensity Image

bspline.description: Parameters for B-Spline. Adaptive smoothing is applied to intensity images if smoothing weights > 0.
bspline.title: B-Spline Parameters

initialization.description: Initialize the FMM parameters. options include Random, Otsu, KMeans, PriorProbabilityImages, and PriorLabelImage.
initialization.title: Initialization

partial_volume_label_set.description: Model mixtures of classes within single voxels. Specify labels for each partial volume class.
partial_volume_label_set.title: Partial Volume Label Set

use_partial_volume_likelihoods.description: Whether to use partial volume likelihoods. A value of 1 considers the partial volume class separate from tissue classes.
use_partial_volume_likelihoods.title: Use Partial Volume Likelihoods

posterior_formulation.description: Specify posterior probability formulation. Options are Socrates, Plato, Aristotle, or Sigmoid.
posterior_formulation.title: Posterior Formulation

mask_image.description: The required image mask defines the region to be labeled by Atropos.
mask_image.title: Mask Image

convergence.description: Determine convergence based on mean maximum posterior probability over region of interest.
convergence.title: Convergence

likelihood_model.description: Specify parametric or non-parametric likelihood model. Options include Gaussian, HistogramParzenWindows, ManifoldParzenWindows, among others.
likelihood_model.title: Likelihood Model

mrf.description: Markov Random Field parameters to enforce spatial constraints on segmentation.
mrf.title: MRF Parameters

icm.description: ICM (Iterated Conditional Modes) parameters for asynchronous updating.
icm.title: ICM Parameters

use_random_seed.description: Initialize with a random seed or a constant seed number.
use_random_seed.title: Use Random Seed

output.description: Output labeled image and optionally posterior probability images.
output.title: Output

minimize_memory_usage.description: Minimize memory usage by calculating images on the fly and storing only non-negligible pixel values.
minimize_memory_usage.title: Minimize Memory Usage

winsorize_outliers.description: Options to remove effects of outliers in calculations using methods like BoxPlot or GrubbsRosner.
winsorize_outliers.title: Winsorize Outliers

use_euclidean_distance.description: Propagate labels throughout the mask using a distance transform.
use_euclidean_distance.title: Use Euclidean Distance

label_propagation.description: Control propagation of each prior label by specified lambda and boundary probability.
label_propagation.title: Label Propagation
